entries.displayName: LS Graf Simulator — Loudspeaker Enclosure & Crossover CAD
entries.description: Interactive browser-based loudspeaker enclosure calculator (Sealed, Bass-Reflex, Passive Radiator, 4th/6th-Order Bandpass, Quarter-Wave Transmission Line, Multi-Segment Horn, Open Baffle) and Passive RLC / Active DSP Crossover simulator with a 1,308-driver Thiele-Small database.

Simulate a quarter-wave transmission line or exponential horn loudspeaker using Transfer Matrix Method
Calculate Linkwitz Transform biquad filters and DSP time alignment delay for an active studio monitor

entries.description: Machine-readable Markdown reference guide containing Thiele-Small equations, Helmholtz port tuning formulas, Linkwitz-Riley crossover synthesis, Zobel/L-Pad/Baffle-Step formulas, and FAQs.
